description: Change any of a listing's details: name, tagline, description, category, pricingModel, priceFrom, basedIn, bestFor, demoVideo, technologies, platforms, audiences, tags, links. Send only what changes; null or an empty list clears a field. Categories, technologies, platforms, audiences and tags are slugs from get_listing_options. A demo video must be a YouTube, Vimeo, Loom or Arcade link to a real, public video. Links are the listing's pages elsewhere (X, GitHub, LinkedIn, App Store, Google Play, Product Hunt, YouTube channel, Discord, Instagram), one per kind. A draft changes at once; on a live listing a new name, category, video or link, or a rewrite, waits for review. Needs listings:write.

audiences.description: Who it's for (slugs); replaces the list.

basedIn.description: Where the business is, like "Bristol, UK" (up to 60 characters).

bestFor.description: Who it suits best, finishing "Best for …" (up to 40 characters).

category.description: The one category it's filed under (a slug).

demoVideo.description: A YouTube, Vimeo, Loom or Arcade link to a public video or demo.

links.description: Its links elsewhere, one per kind, each on that kind's own site (get_listing_options shows each kind's example); replaces the list, and an empty list clears it.

platforms.description: Where it runs (slugs); replaces the list.

priceFrom.description: Its cheapest paid plan; null clears it.

tags.description: Its tags (slugs of existing tags only); replaces the list.

technologies.description: What it's built with (slugs); replaces the list.

name: update_listing
title: Edit a listing
